services.name: Trainee Program
services.desc: Founded in 1993, the nationally-recognized Richmond Ballet Trainee Program offers select advanced students a transitional experience to bridge the gap between the academic ballet setting and the world of professional dance. The Richmond Ballet Trainee Program is one of the few in this country that enables aspiring dancers to pursue formal dance training and gain valuable performance experience with a professional company. Each year, Richmond Ballet chooses 12-14 students to participate in the Richmond Ballet Trainee Program. services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Have a fairy tale birthday! Enjoy a Cinderella, The Nutcracker*, or The Sleeping Beauty themed party with a special performance by a ballerina and a fun movement class for your guests. Parties are for girls and boys ages 4-10. Our Ballet Birthday Parties include:- private party held in the Richmond Ballet state-of-the-art facility- 45-minute studio session with two ballerinas who lead participants in a warm-up and movement class, demonstrate dances from the theme ballet, and invite party participants to dance roles of various characters using costumes and props provided by Richmond Ballet- 45-minute party room session, set up for present opening, birthday cake, and refreshments- Pointe shoe
